NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_15: {SAY:captaincamo}After all that, I've still completed one of my plans.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_16: {SAY:captaincamo}I got most of my troops powered up from the radiation.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_18: {SAY:captaincamo}Even though you prevented my revenge, I won.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_21: {NPC_EXIT:captaincamo}{EXCITED:crazydave}Big words for someone who just ate dust!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_23: {SAY:winnie}We failed to stop his plot to power up his troops.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_24: {SAY:winnie}This could prove troublesome in the future.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_25: {SAY:crazydave}Come on Penny! Look at it on the bright side!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_26: {SAY:crazydave}We stuck it to the bad guy! And nobody got hurt!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_4: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Tired from ordering other zombies around all day?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Your laser cannon has been successfully destroyed, Camo.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_1_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, prepare yourself for the following information.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_1_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}All of the zombies from the rocket appear to be from the "Hero-Con" event.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_1_INTRO_15: {EXCITED:crazydave}I've already got our costumed plants ready!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_1_INTRO_16: {EXCITED:crazydave}Good thing we brought 'em for the journey!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_1_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Yes, we have arrived to Meteor Z.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_1_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}Wait, isn't this the place that gives zombies superpowers?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_1_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}According to records from the L.E.A.F team, some zombies who crash landed here years ago got superpowers.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_1_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}It's all due to the unique radiation of the meteorite.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_1_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}However, most of it got absorbed during that incident.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_1_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}This location has had a reputation of being mysterious ever since.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_1_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}What about that zombie rocket we saw earlier?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Woah, there's a LOT more of those heroes fellas than I remember.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_2_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}This is very likely the doing of General Camo.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_2_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Last time we fought a hero-themed army, it was his doing.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}It would be logical to conclude that this is yet another scheme.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_2_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Therefore, I will provide the same means we used to defeat him last time.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_2_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Plant Food Tiles will trigger the Plant Food effect of a plant once it's planted on them.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_3_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}Camo doesn't seem up for conversation right now.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_3_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting a large influx of Repairimps.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_3_INTRO_14: {SAY:crazydave}Ugh, what are those ugly things they're carrying?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_3_INTRO_3: {SAY:captaincamo}I'm a little busy right now, but I'll see if I can fit you in.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_3_INTRO_5: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}General Guy! What are you doing here?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_3_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}I knew this was another one of your schemes.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_3_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Are you trying to give your new "army" superpowers?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_3_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}Are you aware that the radiation from Meteor Z has already been absorbed?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting a presence of strange zombie tricks.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_10: {TIRED:captaincamo}Gotta keep myself composed, it's not good for the heart.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_13: {EXCITED:captaincamo}Since you BANISHED me from my own time period-!!!!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_14: {SAY:captaincamo}I need to create an army all of my own.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_15: {SAY:crazydave}Using those heroes guys? They're total wimps!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}If you intend to power them up with this meteor's radiation, you're too late.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_18: {SAY:captaincamo}Or so you'd think. There's still enough juice in this thing to power up an army.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_19: {SAY:captaincamo}You just need to know where to dig, hahaha!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}Zombie tricks... now that's something I haven't heard about in a while.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_21: {SAY:captaincamo}I could be lying, want to find out?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_22: {SAY:captaincamo}Besides, I'm here for more personal reasons as well.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_23: {SAY:captaincamo}Now get ready! Some bad natural satellites are about to rise!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:captaincamo}{PLAYFUL:captaincamo}Oh, I've been saving this just for you.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_4: {SAY:captaincamo}I've done thorough research on how to utilize these heroic tricks to my advantage.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_5: {SAY:captaincamo}Who knew nerds could actually be useful for something.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_8: {SAY:captaincamo}Oh, if I could get my hands-
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:captaincamo}{SAY:captaincamo}You might be interested to know that I actually dug up the history of this place.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_10: {SAY:captaincamo}And this just so happens to be the location where one of them originated.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_11: {SAY:captaincamo}So today, I'm sending in the Huge-Gigantacus lookalikes...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_13: {SAY:captaincamo}By recreating these circumstances, I'll have a superpowered soldier for myself!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_14: {SAY:captaincamo}One that's going to be in the same league as the others!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_15: {SAY:captaincamo}So do your thing, gardeners. Emulate evolution and wipe out the "Gigantacuses" that have no potential!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_2: {SAY:captaincamo}Zomboss had quite a few heroes before he assembled our initiative squad, huh?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_3: {SAY:captaincamo}It's obvious the moron lost contact with most of them.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_4: {SAY:captaincamo}So typical for him to let go of useful assets...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_5: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}According to recent records, most of the zombie heroes created by Zombot Hero-Tron 5000 are retired.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_6: {SAY:crazydave}Yeah, they used to be a pain but uh...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}I heard a lot of 'em left Boss Man behind and just sign autographs for long lines these days.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_9: {SAY:captaincamo}I think a proper accident is exactly what it takes to create a real new "hero."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting a powerful laser.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_11: {EXCITED:winnie}It's been cloaked all this time... it's on Camo's rocket!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}General Camo is trying to blow up the moon!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_18: {SAY:crazydave}It's got a cute rabbit on it!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_19: {SAY:winnie}General Camo, blowing up the moon isn't beneficial in any way for someone like you.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_2: {SAY:captaincamo}None of them were strong enough? Psh.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_20: {SAY:winnie}Why would you want to do that?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_21: {EXCITED:captaincamo}Oh trust me scrap heap, I know EXACTLY what I'm doing.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_22: {SAY:captaincamo}This will assert my power over all the zombies, but most importantly-
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_23: {SHOUT:captaincamo}Get rid of that MORON'S STUPID UGLY MUG!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_24: {SHOUT:captaincamo}HOW CAN ANY OF YOU SLEEP WITH THAT IGNORAMOUS'S FACE STARING DOWN AT YOU EACH NIGHT!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_29: {SAY:winnie}Dr. Zomboss carving his face into the moon?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_30: {SAY:captaincamo}I'm not going to let that monument to stupidity stay up in the night sky!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_32: {NPC_EXIT:captaincamo}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting the laser cannon charging.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_33: {SAY:winnie}It's going to be fully functional in three days!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_34: {TIRED:crazydave}Oh brother. Now this is truly despicable.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:captaincamo}If I can't have super soldiers... I'll have my revenge!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_6: {SAY:captaincamo}Do you ever look up at the clear night sky?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_9_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:captaincamo}{PLAYFUL:captaincamo}Hah! You idiots focused on the laser and forgot all about the radiation!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_9_INTRO_10: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Uh, what? Sorry, I was eating all the funky cheese off the ground.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_9_INTRO_4: {SAY:captaincamo}Thanks to the utter stupidity of both of you, I'm getting everything I came here for.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_9_INTRO_5: {SAY:captaincamo}Some of my troops have already soaked in that radiation goodness!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_9_INTRO_6: {SAY:captaincamo}And my laser cannon is on its way to wipe that grin off the face of the king!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_9_INTRO_8: {NPC_EXIT:captaincamo}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting zombies with heightened attributes.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting signs of yet another nefarious scheme by Dr. Zomboss!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_10: {SAY:zombossicon}My head is my temple and nobody gets to insult it!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_11: {SAY:zombossicon}Anyways, I want to be a movie director!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_12: {SAY:zombossicon}But, coming up with original stories is hard!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_13: {SAY:zombossicon}So, I'll just take cues from Hollywood:
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_14: {SAY:zombossicon}Remake existing movies and claim them as my own work!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Scheme!? I'm merely providing myself with a creative outlet!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Why does this creative outlet set off my alarms, then?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}I need your lawn as set dressing!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_8: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}If that vision is to have a huge head, you've done it!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_05_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}For this shoot, I'm going to need you all to stand perfectly still!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_05_INTRO_10: {SAY:zombossicon}They're about to invade! Look shocked, terrified!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_05_INTRO_11: {SAY:zombossicon}Don't screw this one up like you've been doing the rest!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_05_INTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}Allow my employees to completely overtake the field!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_05_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}Their makeup and VFX will do the rest!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_05_INTRO_7: {SAY:zombossicon}Oh, it's going to be a great one!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_05_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}My zombies play the terrifying aliens, and you all play...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_06_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}Make the Gargantuar look mighty and fearsome!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_06_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}We can't let our main antagonist get defeated in his introduction scene!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_09_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}This time, I'm sending fearsome robot assassins from the future to your doorstep!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_09_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}For dramatic effect, you need to sacrifice your brains!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_10_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Because of your lack of cooperation, all my movies have been bombing with test audiences!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_10_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}So, I'm going to be recreating an old classic.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_10_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}I'm putting myself in the starring role!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_10_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}Regardless of your cooperation, I'll have a thrilling conclusion to my movie-making career!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_10_OUTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}No more remakes from you, Boss Man!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_10_OUTRO_2: {EXCITED:winnie}Your rip-off movies are finally going to the bargain bin, Zomboss!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_10_OUTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}Next time, you're gonna need a bigger Lily Pad!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PICKLEDPEPPER_1_INT: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, what are we doing back here? Is it someone's birthday?
{TIRED:crazydave}Bummer. Couldn't even bake a cake for the occassion...
{SAY:winnie}My scans have detected a plant in need in rescuing across time.
{SAY:winnie}It appears the remaining holiday madness has manifested a new variant of Jalapeno.
{SAY:winnie}Pickled Pepper acts much like its predecessor. It burns zombies around an area.
{SAY:winnie}However, it burns through a vertical column instead of a lane.
{SAY:crazydave}Pickled... Pepper? That name rings a bell.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Too faint for me to remember though. Anyway, let's rescue this plant in a pickle!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PICKLEDPEPPER_3_INT: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Brr... how did that fella end up all the way back here?
{SAY:winnie}Pickled Pepper is a curious case of a plant that was once forgotten and lost to time.
{SAY:winnie}Much like previous plants we've rescued before.
{SAY:winnie}So expect drastic detours across time and space in order for us to pick up the packets scattered all over.
{SAY:crazydave}Poor thing... who could leave them just drifting around the place?
{SAY:winnie}Fortunately, it shall prove quite useful for the iceblocks on the lawn.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PICKLEDPEPPER_4_INT: {EXCITED:crazydave}I don't want to get stranded with those weirdos!
{SAY:winnie}Unlike our previous misadventure here, we are able to exit at will.
{TIRED:winnie}And please, refrain from screaming into the void again.
{TIRED:winnie}As mentioned before, no echoes will take place.
{SAY:crazydave}Aww. That's the only fun I ever got in here!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PICKLEDPEPPER_8_OUT: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}We have successfully rescued the Pickled Pepper.
{SAY:crazydave}Now that I'm seeing it up close... I still can't quite put my finger on it.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}But hey, good thing you're no longer lost to time!
{EXCITED:crazydave}Hope you enjoy our company! The other plants would love to hang out!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_POOLPARTY_01_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Woah, Penny! What're we doin' back here?
{SAY:winnie}Hold off the leisure for now, there might also be a plant in need of rescuing here shortly.
{SAY:winnie}If my memory drives are correct, the pool will limit planting capabilities.
{SAY:winnie}So placing down Lily Pads will be of importance to fend off intruders traversing it.
{SAY:winnie}Be on the lookout for an alternate, compact version of the Shield Zombie too.
{SAY:crazydave}Huh? I thought that was the cleanup crew!
{SAY:crazydave}I know we talked about cleaning our neighbor's pool a few weeks ago...
{SHOUT:crazydave}BUT I NEED TO MAKE THE MOST OF MY TACO FIRST!
{SAY:crazydave}Aw. I was just about to take a second bite!
{SAY:winnie}My scanners have been detecting anomalous time particles here in the backyard as well.
{SAY:crazydave}At least I can still take a dip in the pool.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_POOLPARTY_02_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, my systems have yielded worth-while results.
{SAY:winnie}Beware of their inflatables, as it makes them navigate the pool faster than on land.
{SAY:winnie}It appears my scans have also noticed that some have submerged themselves underwater.
{SAY:crazydave}Bummer. Guess my pool cleaning work is gonna be cut out for me once we're done.
{SAY:winnie}First and foremost: we do indeed have a new plant to retrieve.
{SAY:winnie}Lotus Pod is an interesting specimen capable of switching abilities depending on where it is placed.
{SAY:winnie}On land, it lobs heavy-hitting torpedoes at a zombie.
{SAY:winnie}While on water, it launches swift torpedoes that speed through the pool.
{SAY:winnie}Dealing damage to multiple targets in an area once it hits.
{SAY:winnie}On another topic, the zombies have some newfound strategies.
{SAY:crazydave}Yeah, uh, I think they found their ducky tube supply again from the last time they were here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_POOLPARTY_05_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Hey neighbor! Came by real quick to tell you about something crazy!
{SAY:crazydave}Unless I manage to avoid getting hit entirely!
{SAY:crazydave}Wait, uh oh... I'd watch out though.
{SAY:crazydave}The zombies here could probably do that with peas.
{SAY:crazydave}And we can't have that! Only I can be crazy!
{SAY:crazydave}She said she'd be busy analyzing stuff somewhere else.
{SAY:crazydave}No clue why, but she did tell me something exciting before leaving.
{SAY:crazydave}The zombies used some sort of wackymajig to make themselves smaller!
{SAY:crazydave}How can they do that?! I sure wish I could!
{SAY:crazydave}When I'm small, I bet I can eat tacos twice as fast!
{SAY:crazydave}Just that I'd probably be knocked unconscious by a squirbo in one hit.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_POOLPARTY_08_OUTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}We have successfully secured the Lotus Pod.
{SAY:crazydave}Hopefully not at nighttime though, I'd hate to clean the pool at night!
{SAY:winnie}This'll prove quite an important ally moving forward.
{SAY:crazydave}And now we can get back to cleaning the pool!
{SAY:winnie}We have important matters to handle elsewhere.
{SAY:winnie}I'm afraid Zomboss has a new plot brewing.
{SAY:winnie}Data is currently inefficient but it is likely nothing pleasant.
{SAY:crazydave}Fine, I'll go deal with this some other time.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_10_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I am detecting another Zombie threat approaching.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_10_INTRO_11: {EXCITED:crazydave}He was in this really weird dream I had a while back after I stuffed myself with hot sauce.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_10_INTRO_12: {TIRED:crazydave}I don't remember much of it, just that it was crazy.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_10_INTRO_13: {SAY:crazydave}That means I must be able to see into the future!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_10_INTRO_14: {SAY:crazydave}I should try and bet in the squirbo race sometime!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_10_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}One step at a time, User Dave. I'm 62.5% charged, so we still have to hold out for a while longer.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_10_INTRO_16: {EXCITED:crazydave}Yeah, I don't want this guy getting in...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_10_INTRO_17: {EXCITED:crazydave}...and sniffing my prized collection of Leapfrog Quarterly!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_10_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Another one? Man, with all these zombies here I feel kinda bad.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_10_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}Boss Man has dumped so many guys here and so many are lost...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_10_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Then you won't enjoy hearing of The Sniffer.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_10_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Imps with large noses that would rather smell our plants than eat them.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_10_INTRO_6: {SAY:crazydave}Being stuck around all that Zombie funk must-
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_11_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}I am trying my best, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_11_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}I think I am beginning to hallucinate.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_11_INTRO_6: {TIRED:crazydave}I've even begun to see zombies with Kiwibeast on their heads...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_11_INTRO_8: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave, I'm not sure how to say this...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_15_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}What are you doing all stranded in here?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_15_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}Hop in our RV, we'll get you home!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_INTRO_13: {SAY:crazydave}That can't be right. Can you run that again?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}Seems to be, it's not an error.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}These Zomberts are showing an average intelligence level of a rat.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}I meant in the literal sense. They're barely conscious.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_INTRO_19: {SAY:crazydave}I did not expect Boss Man to be so generous to his nephew.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:winnie}We should be able to leave today.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_INTRO_24: {SAY:winnie}This will be far from a battle of wits.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}We still need to find a way outta here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}At this point I've sorta forgotten where we came from anymore.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}I have detected a familiar face. Unbelievably...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}Zombert, of all our adversaries, might be our key to plan a safe route.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_OUTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}My systems are once again fully operational!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_OUTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}What route are we taking, User Dave?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_OUTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}One of the Zombies dropped an old Piñata Party invitation of mine.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_OUTRO_6: {SAY:crazydave}Let's just follow the horde right about there.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_OUTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Please remind me, User Dave, how did you manage to...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_16_OUTRO_9: {SAY:crazydave}It's been over a decade now, I don't remember it too well.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, what happened? Why did we stop?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_10: {EXCITED:crazydave}Oh, I've seen some of those ZCorp doohickeys being sold!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_11: {SAY:crazydave}Apparently they're trying to "commercialize time travel" or something like that.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}Perhaps that is why the zombies are working on this highway as we speak.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_13: {SAY:crazydave}Should I ask if they have an extra jerry can we can use?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}We should remain cautious while I recharge.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_2: {TIRED:winnie}Apologies, User Dave, but I have abruptly run out of energy.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}So it appears we are currently stranded.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}And I cannot determine our current location.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}Dang, I thought this was the fastest route to get home.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_6: {TIRED:crazydave}I knew we should've made a left turn at Wild West...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Last time I'm asking Travel Log for directions.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}It appears this highway is still under construction.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Quite a new phenomenon, it seems inter-temporal transportation has become more widespread.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}User Dave, I regret to inform you, but we're seemingly not the only people stranded on this dimensional highway.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}Circumstances provide us no such luxury this time, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}I suspect these zombies will attempt to "hitch a ride" with us out of this place.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_12: {SAY:crazydave}I'm not giving free rides to zombies! Especially ones holding shovels menacingly!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_13: {SAY:crazydave}Wait, I don't think that's the right way to handle a shovel.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}Indeed, User Dave. These zombies have been abandoned here for one reason or another.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}But the unifying factor seems to be their deviant behavior compared to their peers.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_16: {SAY:winnie}So stay alert. We might find some familiar faces around behaving in a completely different manner than we're used to.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}I can see that! I've seen portals come and go whenever we were driving before...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}...but this is the first time it has gotten so close and personal!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}It seemingly doesn't end there, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Our presence seems to have attracted the other denizens of this "no man's land."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Things would be much simpler if that were the case. I'm referring to hitchhikers, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}Zombies that have been stranded in this rift between timelines.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_9: {SAY:crazydave}Oh, that's right! I usually just drive past em, like the portals!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_3_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Alright Penny, I'm going to be real with you.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_3_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}I'm sensing a traffic jam up ahead.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_3_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}It has been caused by the fear of the interdimensional highway.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_3_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}They roam the rift following the winds of time.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_3_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}General advice is to seek immediate shelter.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_3_INTRO_2: {TIRED:crazydave}This place is kinda freaking me out.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_3_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}I mean, they were holding their shovels ABOVE their heads!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_3_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:crazydave}You shouldn't be able to do that!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_3_INTRO_5: {TIRED:winnie}This sort of interdimensional weirdness seems to be a running theme.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_3_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}I'm sensing more oddball zombies on the horizon.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_3_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}What kind of weirdos are we going to run into now?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_3_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Seems they're more likely to run into us, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_4_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I've got something to show to you on the scanners...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_4_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}...with the plants that we have met in our journey.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_4_INTRO_11: {SAY:crazydave}Gross! You're saying that they WEREN'T pretending to be plants?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_4_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}Based on your description and their sudden disappearance...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_4_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}It is more than likely that Dr. Zomboss must've deemed these zombie-botanical hybrids as failed experiments.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_4_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}...and has thrown them out here to bury the project completely.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_4_INTRO_16: {TIRED:crazydave}I'm going to need a minute, I think I'm gonna be sick...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_4_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:crazydave}So THAT'S where these went! I haven't seen some of these guys in forever!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_4_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:winnie}You've had some sort of encounter with these peculiar zombies before, User Dave?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_4_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Neighbor, remember the time they tried to get into your house by pretending to be plants?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_4_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}Plants couldn't even walk back then! They were fooling no one! Good times.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_4_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, my sensors do determine that these strange zombies share some DNA composition
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_6_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}No need for scanners this time, Penny.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_6_INTRO_10: {SAY:crazydave}Have you found any fuel yet, by chance?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_6_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, I do not need fuel. Remember, I am an electric vehicle.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_6_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}Simply waiting until I recharge will suffice.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_6_INTRO_13: {SAY:crazydave}But Penny, we don't have a choice anymore.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_6_INTRO_14: {SAY:crazydave}Penny... You need to BE the fuel.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_6_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}Just don't look at the face, User Dave. Cover your eyes.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_6_INTRO_3: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}If I just focus hard enough... I can BE the binoculars.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_6_INTRO_6: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Well, that is one peculiar Barrel Roller.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_6_INTRO_8: {EXCITED:crazydave}What on Earth is that Gargantuar with a baby face?!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_6_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}I've seen Impgantuars before, but this is somehow worse!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_7_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}Seems like some leftovers of the plants-zombies fusion experiment have evolved into new species...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_7_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Penny, did I fall asleep *cough* with a packet of those extra spicy chips on my face again *cough*?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_7_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Although I have detected a large percentage of Potato Chip dust in the air today.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_7_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Then, I have *cough* forgotten to clean the bags from the front seat.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_7_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}I believe that you are not the reason for it.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_7_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}My scanners detect a very unstable amalgam between a zombie and a Potato Chip.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_9_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{TIRED:crazydave}Where do all these weirdos even keep coming from?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_9_INTRO_10: {SAY:crazydave}Are there any signs of them slowing down, at least?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_9_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}Area proximity scanned, User Dave. Results still show gradual increases.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_9_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}More specifically, more hitchhikers are flocking towards our direction.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_9_INTRO_13: {SAY:crazydave}Wow, can you imagine being a zombie that nobody wanted to let into a time period.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_9_INTRO_14: {SAY:crazydave}I kind of get the baby face cases...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_9_INTRO_15: {SAY:crazydave}...but I've also seen some zombies that just have obnoxious gimmicks to them.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_9_INTRO_16: {SAY:crazydave}Imagine being so annoying that not even your peers let you in.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_9_INTRO_2: {TIRED:crazydave}Why are there so many of them on the dimensional highway?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_9_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I've done some research while recharging, and I think I may have a plausible theory.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_9_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}All of the accessible time eras that zombies and ourselves can travel to have defined entry points.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_9_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}All the zombies that travel to them must have been able to pass those entry points.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_9_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}And up until recently, that necessitated approval from Dr. Zomboss or other powerful zombies from various time eras.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_9_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}So, you're saying... Nobody wanted to let them in?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_SHADOWLURKERS_01_IN: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Jeepers, Penny! Somebody cut out the lights!
{EXCITED:winnie}This shadow lurker is also capable of powering other shadow plants on its tile.
{SAY:crazydave}Seems handy! Though, I wonder what my old pal Gloom-shroom has been up to.
{EXCITED:crazydave}This vine fella's got the spirit, but he's a little too spooky!
{SAY:winnie}User Dave, we have been through this before.
{SAY:winnie}Nobody has turned off the lights. We are simply experiencing nighttime.
{SAY:crazydave}Oh... well, why are we out here at night, anyways?
{EXCITED:crazydave}We gotta go teach that Mr. Boss Man that he can't play tricks with tacos!
{SAY:winnie}I have detected a gloomy ally, User Dave.
{SHOUT:crazydave}GLOOM-SHROOM?!?! I'VE BEEN WAITING FOR THIS MOMENT FOREVER!
{SAY:winnie}The Gloom Vine can attack around it in a 3x3 area.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_SHADOWLURKERS_02_IN: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, it appears some alternate zombie threats are coming out of the shadows.
{SAY:winnie}The Dark Explorer appears to be an Explorer Zombie from medieval times.
{SAY:winnie}You are correct, User Dave. I will need to find more data on them.
{SAY:winnie}The other new threat is the Powder-Keg Barrel Roller.
{SAY:winnie}These alternative Barrel Rollers are pushing barrels laced with explosives.
{TIRED:crazydave}I feel like that's probably a safety risk.
{SAY:winnie}Indeed it is, User Dave. For our plants, not the zombies pushing them.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Those guys took our beloved friend GLOOM-SHROOM!
{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I believe you are mistaken.
{SAY:winnie}These zombies have only captured the Gloom Vine, not the Gloom-shroom.
{SAY:winnie}Gloom-shroom is currently enjoying his retirement, according to my data.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Oh. That's right. Forgot we were lookin' for the vine guy.
{SAY:winnie}These new zombies are alternative versions of other zombies we have encountered before.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_SHADOWLURKERS_04_IN: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}What's with those spooky new tiles on the lawn?
{SAY:winnie}Data shows that these are Boosting Tiles, User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}Zombies that step on them can receive toughness, speed, or invincibility boosts.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Invincibility?! These weird zombie guys just won't play fair!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_SHADOWLURKERS_07_IN: {EXCITED:crazydave}It must be a sign we're getting close to Gloom Vine!
{SAY:winnie}User Dave, this is an old gardener's myth.
{SAY:winnie}Gloom Vine is not able to impact the current weather.
{SAY:winnie}Local weather seems to forecast sudden wind chills.
{SAY:winnie}We should bring heating to be safe. It's going to be a cold night.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_SHADOWLURKERS_08_IN: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}This is it, User Dave. We have almost rescued the Gloom Vine.
{SAY:winnie}We have one last challenge to overcome.
{SAY:winnie}Power Tiles are on our side, however, the zombies have Boosting Tiles on theirs.
{SAY:winnie}A massive attack is approaching. We must be prepared.
{EXCITED:crazydave}We've got this, Penny! Gloom Vine, here we come!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_SHADOWLURKERS_08_OU: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Perhaps I can arrange a clean-up operation, User Dave.
{EXCITED:crazydave}That'd be great, Penny! Hopefully it can be done before I get my taco back...
{SAY:winnie}I will see what I can do.
{EXCITED:winnie}We have successfully acquired the Gloom Vine!
{EXCITED:crazydave}It's been fun revisiting the night with all our new pals!
{SAY:crazydave}Hey, neighbor, we should clean out your old pool sometime.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Once we get my taco back we should celebrate with a splash!
{EXCITED:crazydave}We could invite all our plant friends and Gloom Vine too!
{TIRED:crazydave}Not the zombies, though. Those guys suck.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_TORCHWOOD_RFL_01_IN: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I detect high traces of temporal meddling.
{SAY:winnie}Our misadventures in history have dispersed some familiar faces through time and space.
{EXCITED:winnie}One of these victims is the trustworthy Torchwood!
{SAY:winnie}My scanners have detected his muffled SOS signal.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_TORCHWOOD_RFL_02_IN: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, it seems Torchwood has picked up some new tricks!
{EXCITED:winnie}Torchwood can now light up peas multiple times for huge damage!
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Okay, I didn't know he'd get THAT mad about that bet!
{EXCITED:winnie}Try planting multiple Torchwoods in a row!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_TORCHWOOD_RFL_08_OU: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}We have successfully rescued the Torchwood, User Dave.
{EXCITED:winnie}He will make for a powerful addition to our collection!
{TIRED:crazydave}Welp, guess I'm gonna be short 20 bucks...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_01_IN: {SAY:winnie}We've traveled back before the age of Power Plants.
{SAY:winnie}Any plants we choose will be at Level 1 while we're here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_02_IN: {SAY:winnie}My sensors detect that we are stuck in a time loop.
{SAY:winnie}The zombies we faced the first time have had their strength boosted!
{SAY:winnie}As these boosts escalate, the zombie threat may soon be insurmountable.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Ooo, I want to see how far we can get!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ZOMBIESCALING_10_OU: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Woo! We made it all the way to the end!
{SAY:winnie}I honestly did not expect us to get this far.
{PLAYFUL:winnie}I underestimated the strength of some of our plants!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_10_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SHOUT:crazydave}Is that a Gargantuar in a suit of armor!?
{PLAYFUL:nanny}Heh, who knows? I just thought it'd be nice for these idiots to listen to me for once.
{PLAYFUL:nanny}And just like that, they suddenly do.
{EXCITED:nanny}It's like everything I wanted to happen in this place, happens.
{EXCITED:nanny}Some of them have even begun calling me their queen!
{PLAYFUL:nanny}Now, why don't you give your queen some entertainment?
{EXCITED:nanny}Squash these three and their puny plants!
{NPC_EXIT:nanny}{EXCITED:crazydave}Oh no, you don't! No one shall beat the Great Knight Dave and his troupe!
{EXCITED:crazydave}Come on, neighbor! Let's gather our own army!
{NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}"Everything I wanted to happen in this place... happens...?"
{EXCITED:winnie}This gargantuar also seems to be carrying an imp of nobility.
{SAY:winnie}When defeated, he will drop his queen imp, which will proceed to flee from the lawn.
{SAY:winnie}She needs to be defeated quickly, or else she will summon a cavalry into battle.
{EXCITED:crazydave}This is crazy! I've never faced a gargantuar in armor!
{NPC_ENTER:nanny}{EXCITED:nanny}Haaah... Haha. Crazy, you say? I completely agree.
{EXCITED:winnie}Are you behind this? How did you manage it?
{SAY:winnie}You couldn't even control an imp a couple days ago.
{SAY:winnie}And now you're controlling an army of gargantuars?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_11_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}I think I have a theory, User Dave. Would you be willing to listen?
{SAY:winnie}That it reminds her of her mother's fairytales.
{SAY:winnie}I believe this place was created based on the machinations of her mind.
{SAY:winnie}Since she fell first, the book was responding to her thoughts and created this realm.
{TIRED:crazydave}She dreamed of a fairytale world, and the book granted it?
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Why would a cruel person like her want to live in a fairytale?
{NPC_ENTER:nanny}{PLAYFUL:nanny}So, is that how it is?
{EXCITED:nanny}This world was shaped from the machination of my mind... haha!
{PLAYFUL:nanny}How absurd!
{SAY:crazydave}See, she agrees with me!
{SHOUT:nanny}I'm agreeing with your car, you nitwit.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Can't it wait, Penny? Me and the plants were about to go on another quest!
{TIRED:crazydave}Huh!? So you really did wish for a world like this?
{TIRED:nanny}Huh, maybe I have been. This whole time...
{EXCITED:nanny}To live in a world without nuisances, that is a dream come true!
{SAY:nanny}A world where people listen to me...
{SAY:nanny}A world with no pesky crying imps... no loathsome... despicable bosses!
{EXCITED:nanny}This must be what living on Easy Street feels like... ha. Cough. Haha!
{NPC_EXIT:nanny}{EXCITED:crazydave}She's crazy! And that's coming from me!
{SAY:winnie}Her mania doesn't stop there. She has sent in another assault.
{SAY:crazydave}Welp, looks like we have to pause that quest, friends!
{EXCITED:crazydave}Not to worry! The Great Knight Dave is here to stop the queen's madness!
{SAY:winnie}User Dave, please. This is a matter of utmost urgency.
{TIRED:crazydave}Alright, fine.
{SAY:winnie}Everything in this place seems to link back to The Nanny.
{SAY:winnie}When she first imagined an imp, one magically materialized.
{SAY:winnie}She wished imps would listen to her, and they abruptly called her a queen.
{SAY:winnie}And remember what she said about this place when we talked about fairytales?
{TIRED:crazydave}That it's stupid?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_12_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Another massive wave of zombies is coming, User Dave.

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_14_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}So, what are we gonna do, Penny? How are we gonna-
